name: FLISAT wall storage, light white stained solid pine, 70x9x16 (IKEA Israel)

warm-modern.reason: Estimate: front-facing book shelf in solid wood at 70 wide and 9 deep, right in the spec's size, but a pale white-stained pine (the spec: walnut or smoked oak). Pale-pink and green variants exist and are off-palette.

safety.source: IKEA Israel product page: max load 5 kg; wall fixings sold separately; no EN statement

notes: KIDS SAFETY: wall fixings are not included (the spec wants screws and anchors in the kit); max load 5 kg; no standard stated. Colour is the gap: a walnut or smoked-oak version needs an Israeli maker (ChildWood, Kidikids: listed only, no contact; their pages were not readable by search). Alternative-only (IKEA). Shipping to Israel: cheapest = IKEA Israel standard delivery or pickup (not verified); fastest = not published. Hex estimated; images not downloaded; rights unclear.
